"""Continue only untouched catalogue jobs after the explicit user resume."""
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

from core import colab_artifacts as a

root = Path.cwd()
folder = root / '.benchmark/png-bmp-native-expansion-20261023'
resume = a.document(folder / 'user-resume-contract-20261026.json', 4 * a.MIB)
continuation = a.document(folder / 'unattempted-continuation-contract.json', 4 * a.MIB)
schedule = a.document(folder / 'paced-schedule-contract.json', 4 * a.MIB)
for contract in (resume, continuation, schedule):
    for name, sha in contract['source_sha256'].items():
        if a.digest(a.read(root / name, 4 * a.MIB)) != sha:
            raise ValueError('resume source mismatch')
initial_debit = sum(a.document(p)['reserved_transfer_bytes'] for p in (folder / 'requests').glob('*/reservation.json'))
if initial_debit != resume['old_expansion_debit_bytes']:
    raise ValueError('resume reservation baseline mismatch')
a.put(folder / 'user-resume-attempt-20261026.json', a.encode({'contract_sha256': a.digest(a.encode(resume)), 'retry': False}))
logs = folder / 'user-resume-logs-20261026'
a.directory(logs)
status = 'finished_selected_schedule'
for job in schedule['jobs']:
    manifest = root / job['manifest']
    if a.digest(a.read(manifest, a.MIB)) != job['sha256']:
        raise ValueError('scheduled manifest mismatch')
    consumed = (folder / 'batches' / (manifest.stem + '.attempt.json'),
                folder / 'paced-logs' / (manifest.stem + '.log'),
                folder / 'continued-logs' / (manifest.stem + '.log'),
                logs / (manifest.stem + '.log'))
    if any(path.exists() or path.is_symlink() for path in consumed):
        continue
    row = a.document(manifest)['sources'][0]
    prior = [a.document(p) for p in (folder / 'requests').glob('*.result.json')]
    intents = [a.document(p)['source'] for p in (folder / 'intents').glob('*.json')]
    if any(r['original_sha1'] == row['original_sha1'] for r in prior + intents):
        continue
    accepted = a.document(folder / 'baseline.json')['originals'] + [r for r in prior if r['status'] == 'quality_passed_pending_visual_review']
    counts = Counter(r['native_mode'] for r in accepted)
    groups = Counter((r['group'], r['native_mode']) for r in accepted)
    if counts[row['native_mode']] >= 128 or groups[(row['ancestry_group'], row['native_mode'])] >= 8:
        continue
    debit = sum(a.document(p)['reserved_transfer_bytes'] for p in (folder / 'requests').glob('*/reservation.json'))
    if debit + row['original_bytes'] + 1 > 512 * a.MIB:
        status = 'stopped_transfer_ceiling'
        break
    time.sleep(45)  # The unchanged child adds 15 seconds and the full server cooldown.
    with (logs / (manifest.stem + '.log')).open('xb') as stream:
        run = subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/timeout', '--kill-after=5s', '1800s', sys.executable,
                              str(folder / 'run_batch.py'), '--manifest', str(manifest), '--allow-download'],
                             cwd=root, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=False)
    print(manifest.stem, 'exit', run.returncode, flush=True)
    if run.returncode != 0:
        status = 'stopped_child_unavailable'
        break
final_debit = sum(a.document(p)['reserved_transfer_bytes'] for p in (folder / 'requests').glob('*/reservation.json'))
a.put(folder / 'user-resume-completion-20261026.json', a.encode({
    'status': status, 'new_reserved_transfer_bytes': final_debit,
    'old_reserved_transfer_bytes': 55307394, 'historical_total_bytes': None,
    'failed_sources_retried': False, 'optimizer_updates': 0, 'new_gpu_attempts': 0,
    'roles': 'unassigned', 'training_ready': False, 'automatic_restart': False}))

"""Offline user-resume checks retain every consumed source and allowance."""
import importlib.util
import runpy
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from core import colab_artifacts as a

HERE = Path(__file__).parent.absolute()
SCRIPT = HERE / 'run_user_resume_20261026.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('resume_generated_scheduler_tests', HERE / 'test_paced_metadata.py')
original = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(original)


@pytest.fixture
def setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    f = original.environment.__wrapped__(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (f / 'batches').mkdir()
    (f / 'continued-logs').mkdir()
    (f / 'unattempted-continuation-contract.json').write_bytes(a.encode({'source_sha256': {}}))

    def start(**kwargs):
        calls = original.schedule(f, monkeypatch, **kwargs)
        (f / 'user-resume-contract-20261026.json').write_bytes(a.encode({
            'source_sha256': {}, 'old_expansion_debit_bytes': kwargs.get('debit', 0)}))
        return calls

    return f, start


def run():
    runpy.run_path(str(SCRIPT), run_name='__main__')


def test_untouched_source_once_with_new_records(setup):
    f, start = setup
    calls = start()
    run()
    assert len(calls) == 1
    receipt = a.document(f / 'user-resume-completion-20261026.json')
    assert receipt['status'] == 'finished_selected_schedule'
    assert receipt['optimizer_updates'] == 0 and not receipt['failed_sources_retried']
    assert (f / 'user-resume-attempt-20261026.json').exists()
    assert (f / 'user-resume-logs-20261026/batch-9000.log').exists()
    assert not (f / 'continued-schedule-completion.json').exists()


@pytest.mark.parametrize('marker', ['batches/batch-9000.attempt.json', 'paced-logs/batch-9000.log', 'continued-logs/batch-9000.log'])
def test_every_old_attempt_and_log_consumed(setup, marker):
    f, start = setup
    calls = start()
    (f / marker).write_bytes(b'old evidence')
    run()
    assert not calls and (f / marker).read_bytes() == b'old evidence'


@pytest.mark.parametrize('prior', ['intent', 'result'])
def test_old_upstream_sha_never_retried(setup, prior):
    _, start = setup
    calls = start(prior=prior)
    run()
    assert not calls


@pytest.mark.parametrize('bound', ['group', 'mode', 'budget'])
def test_original_quota_and_transfer_ceiling(setup, bound):
    f, start = setup
    baseline = [{'native_mode': 'L', 'group': 'author-one' if bound == 'group' else str(i)}
                for i in range(8 if bound == 'group' else 128)] if bound != 'budget' else []
    calls = start(baseline=baseline, debit=512 * a.MIB if bound == 'budget' else 0)
    run()
    assert not calls
    if bound == 'budget':
        assert a.document(f / 'user-resume-completion-20261026.json')['status'] == 'stopped_transfer_ceiling'


@pytest.mark.parametrize('bound', ['resume', 'continuation', 'schedule', 'manifest'])
def test_source_bindings_before_child(setup, bound):
    f, start = setup
    calls = start(source_mismatch=bound == 'schedule', manifest_mismatch=bound == 'manifest')
    if bound in ('resume', 'continuation'):
        p = f / ('user-resume-contract-20261026.json' if bound == 'resume' else 'unattempted-continuation-contract.json')
        record = a.document(p)
        marker = f / 'bound-source'
        marker.write_bytes(b'actual')
        record['source_sha256'] = {str(marker.relative_to(Path.cwd())): '0' * 64}
        p.write_bytes(a.encode(record))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='mismatch'):
        run()
    assert not calls


def test_changed_ledger_cannot_reset_baseline(setup):
    f, start = setup
    calls = start(debit=100)
    p = f / 'user-resume-contract-20261026.json'
    record = a.document(p)
    record['old_expansion_debit_bytes'] = 0
    p.write_bytes(a.encode(record))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='baseline mismatch'):
        run()
    assert not calls and not (f / 'user-resume-attempt-20261026.json').exists()


def test_no_restart_of_resume_attempt(setup):
    f, start = setup
    calls = start()
    (f / 'user-resume-attempt-20261026.json').write_bytes(b'consumed')
    with pytest.raises(FileExistsError):
        run()
    assert not calls


def test_failed_child_unavailable_without_retry(setup):
    f, start = setup
    calls = start(returncode=124)
    run()
    assert len(calls) == 1
    assert a.document(f / 'user-resume-completion-20261026.json')['status'] == 'stopped_child_unavailable'

"""Generated offline regression tests for scheduling and metadata completeness."""
import json
import runpy
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest
from core import colab_artifacts as a

HERE = Path(__file__).parent.absolute()
SCHEDULER = HERE / 'run_paced_schedule.py'
BUILDER = HERE / 'build_batch_complete.py'

@pytest.fixture
def environment(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    f = tmp_path / '.benchmark/png-bmp-native-expansion-20261023'
    for name in ('requests', 'intents', 'queue', 'paced-logs', 'reviews', 'evidence'):
        (f / name).mkdir(parents=True)
    (tmp_path / 'benchmarks').mkdir()
    (f / 'baseline.json').write_bytes(a.encode({'originals': []}))
    monkeypatch.setattr(time, 'sleep', lambda delay: None)
    return f


def schedule(f, monkeypatch, *, prior=None, baseline=None, debit=0, returncode=0, source_mismatch=False, manifest_mismatch=False):
    row = {'id': 'new', 'original_sha1': 'a'*40, 'native_mode': 'L', 'ancestry_group': 'author-one', 'original_bytes': 100}
    manifest = f / 'queue/batch-9000.json'
    manifest.write_bytes(a.encode({'sources': [row]}))
    if baseline:
        (f / 'baseline.json').write_bytes(a.encode({'originals': baseline}))
    if prior == 'intent':
        (f / 'intents/previous.json').write_bytes(a.encode({'source': row}))
    if prior == 'result':
        (f / 'requests/previous.result.json').write_bytes(a.encode({**row, 'status': 'unavailable'}))
    if debit:
        (f / 'requests/previous').mkdir()
        (f / 'requests/previous/reservation.json').write_bytes(a.encode({'reserved_transfer_bytes': debit}))
    source = f / 'source.py'
    source.write_bytes(b'original')
    contract = {'source_sha256': {str(source.relative_to(Path.cwd())): ('0'*64 if source_mismatch else a.digest(b'original'))},
                'jobs': [{'manifest': str(manifest.relative_to(Path.cwd())), 'sha256': '0'*64 if manifest_mismatch else a.digest(manifest.read_bytes())}]}
    (f / 'paced-schedule-contract.json').write_bytes(a.encode(contract))
    calls = []
    def child(command, **kwargs):
        assert command[0] == '/usr/bin/timeout' and '1800s' in command
        assert '--allow-download' in command
        assert kwargs['stdout'].name.endswith('batch-9000.log')
        calls.append(command)
        return SimpleNamespace(returncode=returncode)
    monkeypatch.setattr(subprocess, 'run', child)
    return calls


def test_single_source_once(environment, monkeypatch):
    calls = schedule(environment, monkeypatch)
    runpy.run_path(str(SCHEDULER), run_name='__main__')
    assert len(calls) == 1
    result = a.document(environment / 'paced-schedule-completion.json')
    assert result['optimizer_updates'] == 0 and result['failed_sources_retried'] is False


@pytest.mark.parametrize('prior', ['intent', 'result'])
def test_prior_source_is_never_requested(environment, monkeypatch, prior):
    calls = schedule(environment, monkeypatch, prior=prior)
    runpy.run_path(str(SCHEDULER), run_name='__main__')
    assert not calls


@pytest.mark.parametrize('bound', ['group', 'mode', 'budget'])
def test_bounds_before_network(environment, monkeypatch, bound):
    baseline = []
    if bound in ('group', 'mode'):
        baseline = [{'native_mode': 'L', 'group': 'author-one' if bound == 'group' else str(i)} for i in range(8 if bound == 'group' else 128)]
    calls = schedule(environment, monkeypatch, baseline=baseline, debit=512*a.MIB if bound == 'budget' else 0)
    runpy.run_path(str(SCHEDULER), run_name='__main__')
    assert not calls


@pytest.mark.parametrize('mismatch', ['source', 'manifest'])
def test_binding_before_network(environment, monkeypatch, mismatch):
    calls = schedule(environment, monkeypatch, source_mismatch=mismatch=='source', manifest_mismatch=mismatch=='manifest')
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='mismatch'):
        runpy.run_path(str(SCHEDULER), run_name='__main__')
    assert not calls


def test_nonzero_child_is_not_retried(environment, monkeypatch):
    calls = schedule(environment, monkeypatch, returncode=124)
    runpy.run_path(str(SCHEDULER), run_name='__main__')
    assert len(calls) == 1


def test_revision_only_page_cannot_shadow_imageinfo(environment, monkeypatch):
    f = environment
    page = {'pageid': 42, 'title': 'File:Generated.png', 'revisions': [{'revid': 20}], 'imageinfo': [{
        'size': 200000, 'width': 256, 'height': 256, 'mime': 'image/png', 'sha1': 'b'*40,
        'url': 'https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/a/aa/Generated.png?utm_source=commons',
        'metadata': [{'name': 'bitDepth', 'value': 8}, {'name': 'colorType', 'value': 'greyscale'}],
        'extmetadata': {'Artist': {'value': 'Generated Tester'}, 'LicenseShortName': {'value': 'CC BY 4.0'}}}]}
    (f / 'query-a-revision.json').write_bytes(a.encode({'query': {'pages': [{'pageid': 42, 'title': page['title'], 'revisions': [{'revid': 19}]}]}}))
    (f / 'query-z-complete.json').write_bytes(a.encode({'query': {'pages': [page]}}))
    (Path.cwd() / 'benchmarks/png-bmp-native-reviewed-20261023.json').write_bytes(a.encode({'sources': []}))
    selection = f / 'selection-test.json'
    selection.write_bytes(a.encode({'titles': [page['title']], 'source_kind': 'ordinary_photograph'}))
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, 'argv', [str(BUILDER), '9000', str(selection)])
    runpy.run_path(str(BUILDER), run_name='__main__')
    row = a.document(f / 'queue/batch-9000.json')['sources'][0]
    assert row['page_revision'] == 20 and row['native_mode'] == 'L'
    assert row['original_url'].endswith('/Generated.png')
    # A second reviewed batch may reuse identical evidence, never overwrite it.
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, 'argv', [str(BUILDER), '9001', str(selection)])
    runpy.run_path(str(BUILDER), run_name='__main__')
    assert a.document(f / 'queue/batch-9001.json')['sources'] == [row]
